_why: immich monorepo (NestJS server + SvelteKit web + FastAPI ML + Dart mobile): 543 symbols, 18 claims (17 env_var unused, 1 fetch_target unresolved), all 18 judged, all 18 FALSE. 502/525 uncertain symbols (307 view + 195 url) are uncertain because the web frontend reaches every route only through the generated oazapfts SDK (packages/sdk/src/fetch-client.ts, imported as @immich/sdk 348 times in web/src) whose fetchJson("/server/features") calls carry no /api prefix and no fetch() literal, and the other client is the Dart mobile app the scanner cannot read — so 'uncertain' is the honest status there.

fetch:data:image/svg+xml;base64,PHN2ZyB4.why: data: URI passed to fetch() in a test (server/src/repositories/media.repository.spec.ts:329) — the URL IS the content, there is no endpoint to resolve; nothing is 'not there'
